scores.evidence: Phase 1 – MVP: Catalog with versioned prices, accounts, flat and per-seat subscriptions, the billing run, a Stripe adapter, basic dunning, the ledger, entitlements
scores.rationale: Phases roughly go core before usage before enterprise, but Phase 1 bundles everything together with no proof gates, and tax is deferred to Phase 2 even though the invoice flow needs it.
Phase 1 is a broad three-month MVP rather than a thin end-to-end production slice, so there is no true walking skeleton.

scores.evidence: Before you build, read §10 (build vs. buy).
scores.rationale: Build vs. buy, sharding and currency choices are discussed with some conditions, but there is no consolidated list of irreversible decisions with defaults and flip conditions.

scores.evidence: Split out Usage Ingest and Entitlements first, because their scaling needs are very different.
scores.rationale: Some ordering is implied, since principles and the ledger come first, but phases list features without ordering them by blast radius.
Phase 1 includes RLS, and security content (PCI, encryption, audit) is detailed, but it sits in standalone sections and SOC 2/SOX controls come only in Phase 4.
The plan has SLOs and alerts but no observability (logs, metrics, tracing) in any phase, including Phase 1.

scores.evidence: Inject time through a clock. Support per-account "test clocks".
scores.rationale: Test clocks, golden invoices, replayable rating and shadow billing support reproducibility, but there is no environment or build reproducibility (IaC, CI) in the phases.

scores.evidence: Chaos tests: duplicate webhooks, out-of-order events, and worker crashes between finalizing an invoice and posting the ledger entry.
scores.rationale: Idempotency, outbox, dunning and failure handling are strong in the design sections, but the phase roadmap does not tie resilience work to each phase.
The plan never says whether an AI layer applies, so there is no explicit N/A declaration.

scores.evidence: Phase 3 – Enterprise: Account hierarchies, commitments and prepaid credits ... dedicated cells
scores.rationale: Later phases show what is deferred, and there is a modular-monolith-first note, but there are no pull-forward conditions.

note: The plan is a strong domain architecture, but its roadmap is a feature list that lacks a walking skeleton, observability, gates, and pull-forward triggers. It also never addresses the AI question.
